1. Settings: enter the academic year, currency, your classes, subjects and grade bands.
2. Schools: add each school. IDs (SCH01, SCH02...) appear automatically.
3. Teachers, then Classes, then Students: add people. IDs (T001, S0001...) appear automatically. Pick School ID and Class from the dropdowns.
Daily: Attendance. Pick the Student ID and mark P, A or L.
Each term: Grades (scores per subject) and Fees (amount due and paid).
Reports: open Report Card, pick a Student ID, then print.
When you register a school, teacher or student (name, school, class and email filled in), a welcome email is sent automatically. Students' emails go to the guardian.
1. Upload this file to Google Drive, open it, then File > Save as Google Sheets.
2. In the Google Sheet: Extensions > Apps Script. Delete any code, paste the contents of Code.gs, click Save.
3. Go back to the sheet and reload. Use the new menu School System > Enable email notifications and approve the permissions.
4. On Settings, set Send welcome emails to Yes, add your organisation name and admin email, and edit the message if you wish.
5. Test with School System > Send test email to me. Sent emails are recorded on the Email Log tab and stamped in each row.
Limits: free Gmail accounts can send about 100 emails a day, Google Workspace accounts about 1,500. Emails only send when the required cells are filled; a row is never emailed twice.
Report Card: pick the Student ID, then click the Print Report Card button (or School System > Print report card). A window opens with the PDF; click it to print or save.
Results: pick School ID, Class and Term, then click Print Class Results (or School System > Print class results).
Class List: pick School ID and Class, then click Print Class List (or School System > Print class list).
ID Cards and Timetable View: pick School ID and Class, then use the button beside the page (or the School System > Print menu).

The three print buttons sit in a row on the Dashboard; Report Card, Class List, ID Cards and Timetable View also have one beside the page. Add them once with School System > Add print buttons. Without the script, use File > Print on each tab.
AUTOMATIONS (SCHOOL SYSTEM MENU, GOOGLE SHEETS ONLY)
Absence alerts: mark a student A in Attendance and the guardian is emailed straight away. Settings J8 turns this on or off.

Fee reminders: Email > Send fee reminders emails the guardian of every student with a balance, listing what is owed. A student is not reminded again until the number of days in Settings (default 14) has passed.
Report cards by email: pick School ID and Class on the Class List tab, then Email > Email report cards for this class. Each guardian gets the PDF report card.

Year end: Year end > Promote students saves a backup copy, moves every student up one class (in the order of the Classes list in Settings), marks the last class Graduated, and can clear Attendance, Grades and Fees for the new year.
Marks: Grades has Class Work and Exam columns. The final score uses the weights in Settings (default 30% class work, 70% exam). If only one score is entered, it is used as it is.
Timetable: enter lessons on the Timetable tab; the Check column flags a teacher or class booked twice. Staff Attendance feeds Payroll: each day marked A is deducted from pay.

Locking: add admin and teacher emails in Settings (N9:O10), then Setup > Lock formulas and set roles. Everyone gets edit access to the file, formula cells are locked, and teachers can only change Attendance and Grades.
Blue text = type here. Grey cells = formulas, do not overwrite. Italic row 1 of each list is an example: replace it.
IDs follow the row number. Do NOT sort or delete rows in Schools, Classes, Teachers or Students. Add new records at the bottom and mark leavers as Left.
Assumptions: classes follow Nursery to SSS 3 and grade bands are A 80+, B 70-79, C 60-69, D 50-59, F below 50. Change both in Settings.

CLASS LIMIT: each class holds up to 40 active students (change in Settings, Max students per class). The Classes tab shows places left and Open/Full, and Students has a Class Check column. With the script on, a student cannot be placed in a full class: the Class cell is cleared with a message. Each list holds 300 rows. The Dashboard shows 15 schools and the Report Card shows 15 subjects.
To use in Google Sheets: Drive > New > File upload, then open the file with Google Sheets.
NEW: CLASS ATTENDANCE, CLASS GRADES AND EMAIL BUTTONS

New tabs: Class Attendance and Class Grades (after Class List) and Report Files (after Email Log). Each class has its own attendance register and its own marks sheet; nothing is mixed between classes.

Class Attendance: pick School ID, Class, Term and the register date. Type P, A or L for each student in the Mark column, then click Save Attendance. The grid shows the last 20 school days for that class only. Saved marks go into the Attendance tab, so the Dashboard and Report Card keep working.
Attendance emails: on Class Attendance click Email Attendance to Guardians (each guardian receives only their own child's record for the chosen term) or Email Register to Class Teacher.
Class Grades: pick School ID, Class, Term and Subject. Type Class Work and Exam scores, then click Save Grades. Scores go into the Grades tab; the Saved columns show what is already stored.

Term report cards: on Report Card pick the Student ID and a Term (Term 1, Term 2, Term 3 or All terms). Every student gets a separate PDF for each term. Use Email Report Card or Save PDF to Drive. On Results or Class Grades, Email Report Cards sends every guardian their own child's PDF for that class and term.
Report Files lists each term PDF with its Drive link and who it was emailed to. A student already emailed for a term is skipped next time; clear the Status cell to send again.
Term dates: enter start and end dates on Settings (A35:C38) so each term report counts only that term's attendance. Leave blank to count every date.

Set up the buttons once: Extensions > Apps Script > add a new file, paste EmailReports.gs, Save. Reload the sheet, then Email Reports > Run setup and approve the permissions. If you use Lock formulas and set roles, unlock the yellow input cells on Class Attendance and Class Grades for teachers.
Settings: Edit the blue cells. Dropdowns across the workbook read from these lists.
